name: seo-aeo-audit
description: Evidence-first SEO + AEO/GEO website audit that ends in a prioritized change plan.

plugins.name: seo-aeo-audit
plugins.description: Audits a website across ten evidence-based tracks (access & indexation, canonicalization, architecture & link equity, intent, content value, extractability/AEO, entity consensus, experience signals, risk, measurement) and outputs a findings report plus a prioritized change plan with verification steps. Includes a stdlib-only page auditor with answer-engine read-budget analysis.
